guidance.title: A little of you, left somewhere
guidance.about: World of Moments is a quiet map of anonymous thoughts. Wander through words left by others, or choose a place on the map and leave a moment of your own.
guidance.writing: A memory of this place, something small you noticed, a feeling you’re carrying, or words you never said. Joy, longing, and hard days all belong here. A few honest lines are enough.
guidance.example: “I used to take this road home. Today, the rain brought it all back.”
guidance.care: Your words are public, with no name attached. Leave out personal details, write with care for whoever finds them, and keep this space true to its <purpose>purpose</purpose>.

rules.title: Keep a quiet corner of the world
rules.description: This is a place for small, honest thoughts tied to places. Write something another person can pause with, wherever they are in their day.

should.personal: Share a memory, a small observation, or words you never found a chance to say.
should.feelings: Write honestly about joy, sadness, loneliness, grief, or anger. Difficult feelings are welcome too.
should.place: Choose a place that holds meaning for your thought, even if you are far from it now.
should.care: Speak from your own experience and leave room for others to feel differently.

avoid.privacy: Names, contact details, private addresses, or anything that could identify you or someone else.
avoid.attacks: Insults, harassment, hate, threats, or words aimed at shaming a person or group.
avoid.harm: Sexually explicit content, graphic violence, or anything that encourages harm to yourself or others.
avoid.spam: Ads, sales pitches, promotional links, or repeated messages.

clientAuth.privacy: This space uses cookies for sign-in and Cloudflare Turnstile to protect forms. Read our <policy>privacy note</policy>.
clientAuth.privacyBody: Your email and account reference stay private. We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and protect account ownership. Verification emails are delivered through Resend. We use Cloudflare Turnstile in invisible mode to help protect sign-in and registration from automated abuse; it processes browser and device signals under Cloudflare’s Turnstile privacy terms. Public thoughts appear without author names or exact timestamps.
